title: AdicPurityRootComparisons
statement: For the coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions] and the actual coefficient lines [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], define the canonical quotient maps of all nonnegative integral Tate powers. Their zeroth component is the coefficient projection, their first component sends a root tensor to its finite root projection, and their higher components preserve ordered pure tensors. These equations determine the family uniquely. Identify the shifted affine-line tensor powers with the corresponding degree-zero Tate powers shifted by $2d$, using the specified K-flat tensor counit, tensor unit and shift comparisons. The etale/pro-etale comparison is uniquely normalized on every local pure root tensor. Flatness is asserted only when the coefficient prime is invertible in residue fields.
